zh-cn:
新增：MEFrp 强制下线与解除禁用支持，解决服务重启时残留会话导致隧道无法上线的问题。
新增：LoliaFrp 原生 TCP/UDP 双协议同端口隧道创建支持。
修复：LoliaFrp 隧道展示可读备注名称，底层操作精准解析内部标识，修复节点删除报错与 404 幂等处理。
改进：实现隧道进程早期失败与假死挂起检测，增加熔断安全保护机制（指数退避重试，防止被服务商封禁）。
修复：修复 MEFrp 隧道编辑时报 400/403 错误问题。
修复：后台同步任务 TaskCanceledException 未被捕获导致应用异常重启问题。
升级：全面升级至 .NET 11。
改进：规范统一发布流程，区分测试预览版与正式版发布。
en-us:
Added: MEFrp force kick and un-disable support to resolve ghost session online conflicts after restarts.
Added: LoliaFrp native TCP/UDP dual-protocol same-port tunnel creation support.
Fixed: LoliaFrp displays readable remark name; resolves internal identifiers for delete/update/launch operations; idempotent deletion.
Improved: Early failure and hung process detection with circuit breaker protection (exponential backoff against bans).
Fixed: Resolved 400/403 errors when updating MEFrp tunnels.
Fixed: Unhandled TaskCanceledException in background sync worker causing container restart loops.
Upgraded: Full solution upgrade to .NET 11.
Improved: Unified release workflows for preview and production releases.
